title: FeedbackProvenance session/turn/tool-call backtrace refs
detail: Validates FeedbackProvenance::from_session_turn threads turn_sequence + tool_call_id, serde round-trips the extended shape, pre-v2 records deserialize with defaulted None refs, and a mined FeedbackEntry recorded through EntityFeedbackStore preserves populated session_id/turn_sequence/tool_call_id.
